property_description: Welcome to the latest addition to the Signature Series, an exclusive collection of luxury new-construction homes found throughout Charlotte. Two additional bedrooms share a hall bath with a shower/tub combination. An open lounge gives the upper level a second living area, well suited for a media room or additional home office space. Outside, a covered patio with a ceiling fan is ready for lounging and al fresco dining, overlooking a fully fenced backyard with room to play, garden, or entertain, along with a detached 2-car garage. Set among the tree-lined streets and classic bungalows of Wilmore, one of Charlotte's most charming historic neighborhoods, the home offers a walkable, established setting just minutes from South End's restaurants, breweries, and shopping. Both upstairs bedrooms also open to private balconies, a quiet spot for morning coffee, an afternoon book, or winding down after a day on the water. Outside, the Holden Beach lifestyle takes over. Holden Beach sits between Wilmington and Myrtle Beach, so you get a laid-back North Carolina beach town with easy access to dining, shopping, entertainment, and airports for visiting guests. A 2023 build with a pool, ensuite bedrooms, and private outdoor spaces near the sand, 303 Sand Piper works just as well as a full-time coastal home, a second-home escape, or a vacation rental. However you use it, you'll spend more of your days by the water.
